title: He BROKE the Bridge?!
description: A tiny raccoon breaks a footbridge plank, then uses it to rescue a stranded duckling. Original 42-second visual animal story.
hook: At frame one, raccoon snaps the last plank of a bridge; by 2.5s a duckling is stranded above rising water.
script: A raccoon appears to destroy a crossing, alarming a mother duck. It catches the broken plank with a red ribbon, transforms it into a guided raft, saves a duckling on a flooded rock, and reunites the family. A wooden click at the end matches the opening.

character_bible.raccoon: Small gray raccoon, striped tail, orange rain vest.
character_bible.duckling: Tiny yellow duckling, three head tufts, one right-cheek freckle.
character_bible.mother_duck: Cream-colored adult duck, blue-green neck ribbon.
character_bible.props: One weathered plank, one red ribbon, one leaning willow.
character_bible.world: Rainy garden brook flowing left-to-right; bridge and willow on near bank, mossy rock on far bank.
character_bible.style: Original cinematic 3D animation, expressive animal movement, consistent character designs.

rewatch_trigger: At 5.6s the bridge support tilts, hinting why crossing was unsafe.
loop_bridge: Final 0.5s paw/plank close-up and click match first 0.5s.
editing_notes: 42s, 9:16, no narration, little to no subtitles; movement or revelation every 1–3 seconds; action-match cuts and original/licensed audio only.
production_gate: Require 9 distinct coherent animated scenes. No one-clip replay, Pillow stickers, paid generation, auto-upgrade or low-quality upload.
